'''Revaz Kvachakidze''' (born 12 February 1938) is a Georgian [[Sport of athletics|athlete]]. He competed in the [[Athletics at the 1960 Summer Olympics – Men's long jump|men's long jump]] at the [[1960 Summer Olympics]], representing the Soviet Union.<ref name="SportsRef">{{cite Sports-Reference |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/kv/revaz-kvachakidze-1.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200418105228/https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/kv/revaz-kvachakidze-1.html |url-status=dead |archive-date=18 April 2020 |title=Revaz Kvachakidze Olympic Results |access-date=16 December 2017}}</ref>
